checks.hypotheses: SPR class MME; total ergodicity; Holder observables.
checks.conclusion: Exponential mixing; period p>1 requires cyclic components and f^p, not mixing of f.

checks.hypotheses: C^infinity surface; ergodic nu_k weakly converges to mu; h(nu_k)->h_top>0.
checks.conclusion: Both averaged Lyapunov exponents converge; mu need not be ergodic.

checks.conclusion: For every invariant mu: |lambda_1(m)-lambda_1(mu)|<=C sqrt(h(m)-h(mu)). Retain uniqueness.

checks.conclusion: Label as announced/in preparation in this source, not independently verified published proof.

checks.conclusion: Model-specific centralizer classification, not a theorem about every partially hyperbolic map.

checks.conclusion: Do not erase arithmetic/normalization conditions or interchange full-action local rigidity and one-element semilocal rigidity.

reports.author: Bertrand Deroin

checks.hypotheses: Specified family on compact complex algebraic surface; hyperbolic singularity: nonzero eigenvalues, nonreal ratio.
checks.conclusion: Stability means nearby leaf-homeomorphism, not biholomorphism. Rigidity is different.

checks.hypotheses: Riccati family R_{g,n}, simple poles, 2g-2+n>0.
checks.conclusion: Stable representations: faithful quasi-Fuchsian (n=0), faithful Schottky-type (n>0). Not arbitrary surface foliations.

checks.hypotheses: Regular Riccati; fixed compact base, genus>=2; Brownian shortest-geodesic closure.
checks.conclusion: Almost surely t^{-1}[Par(gamma_t)]->dd^c chi with bifurcation support; not varying base, singular Riccati or arbitrary simple loops.

checks.hypotheses: Ilyashenko-type results: invariant-line/divisor restricted families.
checks.conclusion: Do not promote relative Zariski-generic statements to the entire foliation moduli space.

checks.hypotheses: P^2, degree d>=2.
checks.conclusion: Loray-Rebelo gives nonempty Euclidean-open rigid/minimal families; density throughout the bifurcation locus remains a question in the survey.

checks.hypotheses: Jouanolou J_2 on P^2.
checks.conclusion: Structurally stable; Fatou set a holomorphic fibration over Klein quartic, smoothly a locally trivial disc bundle; no dense leaf.

checks.hypotheses: Survey: d=1,2 known; d=3,4,5 numerics.
checks.conclusion: All-degree/Cantor/covering claims retain conjectural status there; see post-survey notice.

checks.hypotheses: Jouanolou-type criterion retains hyperbolic singularities, the specified normal Hermitian metric condition, and no elliptic leaf.
checks.conclusion: Do not replace the metric condition by vague positivity or drop the last hypothesis; not a classification of all stable foliations.
